explanation: Phylum Glomeromycota consists of arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi. They form arbuscules, which are branching invaginations that the fungus makes when invading host plant roots. These fungi form mycorrhizae, which are mutualistic associations between plants and fungi. Although they were previously grouped within Zygomycota, molecular data has shown that Glomeromycota is a distinct genetic group.
